message.reasoning:
I am ready to play Monopoly as an AI player.

I have $832 and both utilities. I own three orange properties and one red. p2 has $1421 and owns Mediterranean, Ventnor, and Pacific.

p3 has $535 and all four railroads. p4 has $992 and owns Marvin Gardens and North Carolina. No color monopolies exist yet, so building is impossible. I have a utility monopoly with 10x rent. I will trade or mortgage to improve my position.

I am weighing whether to trade the utilities. p3 has all four railroads but only $535 cash, so they cannot afford a good offer. p2 has $1421 and owns Mediterranean, Ventnor, and Pacific. I need to decide if building a color monopoly is worth trading them.

No player owns the remaining properties needed to complete my color sets. New York Avenue is in the bank, so trading for it is impossible. Selling the utilities would sacrifice a steady $20–$120 rent stream, so I will not trade them.

I have enough cash to buy New York Avenue and build houses without trading or mortgaging. I will end my turn and keep my income stream intact.
